lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately 5-6 longitudinal rows of high-luminance circular spots. Centroid spacing is highest in the mid-flank region, with spots appearing in a semi-regular staggered grid relative to the head-to-tail axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-grid effect where the largest white blobs are situated at the intersection points of these horizontal and vertical axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the upper half of the lateral flank. These features are defined by a linear highlight on the dorsal edge and a corresponding shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, low-intensity speckles, primarily localized within the anterior-ventral section of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, yellow-and-black striped teleost fish swimming in close proximity to the pectoral fin and lower gill region.
